jobs.title: Associate Software Engineer (.NET, C#, Angular, SQL Server)
jobs.standout: Explicitly framed as an early-career role ('excellent opportunity for an early-career software engineer'), India-based, and the stack lines up closely: Microsoft .NET, C#, Angular, and SQL Server, with exposure to the full SDLC alongside experienced developers and BAs. This is the closest tech + seniority match found this run.
jobs.verify: Exact years-of-experience band and salary were not stated in the search snippet -- confirm both on click-through. Also confirm whether the SQL Server requirement is a hard blocker given the profile's PostgreSQL/EF Core background (transferable but worth addressing directly in the application).
jobs.requirements: Microsoft .NET, C#, Angular, Microsoft SQL Server. Full SDLC exposure: design, build, test, maintain enterprise applications. Works with experienced developers, business analysts, and technical stakeholders in an Agile environment.

jobs.title: Associate Software Engineer / Software Engineer (C# .NET, Angular)
jobs.standout: A dual-tier posting where the Associate tier is explicitly 1-3 years, squarely inside the 0-2.5 year band (the Software Engineer tier at 3+ years should be skipped). Hands-on C#, ASP.NET, .NET, Angular, and SQL.
jobs.verify: Confirm on click-through that you'd be considered/routed to the Associate tier rather than the Software Engineer tier, and that the role is India-remote (location wasn't independently confirmed beyond the search snippet).
jobs.requirements: C#, ASP.NET, .NET, Angular, SQL. Associate tier: 1-3 years software engineering experience. Software Engineer tier: 3+ years (does not meet the hard YOE filter -- apply for Associate tier only).

jobs.title: Application Developer (ASP.NET Core, Angular)
jobs.standout: Strong direct stack match: ASP.NET Core 6/7, Angular 13+, C#, OOP, REST/Web API, SQL, Git, with Azure DevOps called out as desirable -- covers most of the core skill list except CQRS/MediatR and PostgreSQL specifically.
jobs.verify: No explicit years-of-experience figure appeared in the search snippet -- confirm the YOE band on click-through before assuming it fits the 0-2.5 year filter. Location (India-remote) also not independently confirmed.
jobs.requirements: ASP.NET Core 6/7, the broader .NET ecosystem, C#, OOP, structured software development. Angular 13+. RESTful APIs / Web API. SQL development and database querying. Git; Azure DevOps desirable.

jobs.title: Angular Developer (Remote, Full-Time) [AS313]
jobs.standout: Companion posting (same AS313 req family) to a role already surfaced in a prior run's full-stack listing -- this one is Angular-focused with ASP.NET MVC on the backend side, 2+ years Angular required, which is at the top of the qualifying band rather than a stretch.
jobs.verify: The posting wants strong AngularJS (legacy 1.x) experience to maintain/rewrite an existing live codebase, not just modern Angular -- confirm you can speak to that gap before applying, same caveat as the sibling full-stack posting from the prior run.
jobs.requirements: Strong AngularJS experience (read/maintain/rewrite a live codebase). 2+ years shipping Angular 20+ applications. Strong TypeScript. ASP.NET MVC development experience. Git/CI-CD.

jobs.title: .NET Developer
jobs.standout: Direct UAE listing (a top-priority location) for a global IT services provider, with C#, ASP.NET, and Web API as the named stack.
jobs.verify: The 1-3 years experience figure comes from Bayt's aggregate category description for Blackstone eIT .NET roles generally, not confirmed against this specific listing's own text -- verify the exact YOE band, salary (not listed), and whether visa sponsorship is offered on click-through.
jobs.requirements: Bachelor's in Computer Science. C#, ASP.NET, Web API. Full SDLC: requirement analysis, design, coding, testing, deployment. Problem-solving, communication, teamwork.

jobs.title: Angular Developer with .NET
jobs.standout: On-the-ground Chennai option (top preferred location) combining Angular front end with a .NET back end, at a small/growing local company.
jobs.verify: Experience band is ambiguous and inconsistent across sources -- the listing URL slug says 2-4 years, but other descriptions of what appears to be the same or a sibling Diatoz posting say 1-3 years and 2-6 years. Confirm the real minimum on click-through; the low end (1-2) would clear the hard filter but the range as posted may skew senior. Stack also mentions MySQL rather than PostgreSQL and doesn't mention CQRS/Clean Architecture -- treat those as gaps, not confirmed matches.
jobs.requirements: Angular (front end), Microsoft .NET (back end), MySQL. B.E./B.Tech. Full stack web application development.

jobs.title: .Net + Angular + AWS - Full Stack Developer
jobs.standout: C# / ASP.NET Core + Angular stack at a large IT services firm (Encora) with many parallel listings, so there may be nearby openings if this one doesn't fit.
jobs.verify: Could not confirm the years-of-experience band for this specific (non-'Senior') posting -- Encora's clearly-labeled 'Senior' .NET/Angular roles ask for 5+ years, and a 'Mid' .NET role asks for 4+, so this one may skew senior too; treat as unverified until you check YOE on click-through. Also uses AWS rather than Azure for cloud, and location wasn't confirmed as remote-eligible from India.
jobs.requirements: C#, .NET Core, Angular, AWS. Full stack engineering across frontend and backend. (Years of experience and location not confirmed for this specific posting.)

jobs.title: Product Developer - Fresher (Star Hire Program 2026)
jobs.standout: Chennai product company campus-hire program; .NET/.NET Core/C# is one of three acceptable tracks (alongside React.js and Rust), so it's a real (if partial) tech match with genuine product-company mentorship framing.
jobs.verify: Eligibility appears restricted to '2026 graduating' candidates specifically (a campus-hire program), not general 0-2.5 year hires -- confirm you qualify before applying. Also confirm whether the .NET track specifically is open vs. the React/Rust tracks, and that salary/YOE details (not listed) on the actual posting.
jobs.requirements: Strong coding fundamentals. Hands-on exposure to React.js, .NET/.NET Core/C#, or Rust (one track, not all three). 2026 graduating BE/B.Tech only, per program framing.
